note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, claims, and quotes, including the same shared errors: both misread the first edgewise damping as 5% (the page states 3%) and both add a misbound/duplicate flatback claim that assigns the midpoint definition to the normalized arc length position rather than the trailing edge. Both also state the s = 0 and s = 1 facts twice under two entity names and include figure-label claims of marginal engineering value. Neither set captures anything the other misses, so they are effectively equivalent.
remarks: Both extractions share the same edgewise damping error: the page text and image both read '3%, 3%, and 6%' for flapwise, edgewise, and torsional modes, yet both sets report 5% for edgewise and quote a fabricated '3%, 5%, and 6%'. Both also duplicate the s = 0 / s = 1 facts under both 'normalized arc length position coordinate (s)' and 'normalized arc length position', and both add a second flatback claim that misattributes the midpoint of the flatback surface to the s-coordinate instead of the trailing edge. The figure labels (Plane of Rotation, Chord Line, Pitch Axis, Arc Width, Offset, theta_rot) are extracted as generic 'has component'/'has property' claims with no engineering values; they are correct but of low value.
